description: This file provides an image search service with fallback logic, including functions for querying a backend API and a heuristic mock search. It exports a main function 'searchByImage' which searches for products based on an image file and optional alternate text, normalizes backend results, and includes internal helper functions for tokenization, keyword scoring, and loading product data.

methods.name: normalizeBackendResults(data)
methods.description: Normalizes backend search results to a consistent format, resolving product IDs to product objects if necessary.

methods.name: tokenize(text)
methods.description: Converts text into an array of lowercase, alphanumeric tokens.

methods.name: keywordScore(keywords, text)
methods.description: Calculates a score based on the number of keywords found within a text.

methods.name: guessKeywordsFromFilename(name)
methods.description: Generates keywords from a filename by tokenizing it.

methods.name: loadAllProducts()
methods.description: Loads all products from a service or falls back to mock data.

methods.name: computeSimilarityScore(product, keywords)
methods.description: Computes a simple similarity score between a product and a set of keywords based on name and description.

methods.name: mockHeuristicMatch(file, altText)
methods.description: Performs a mock search for products based on heuristics involving filename and alt text keywords.

ctags.name: searchByImage
ctags.pattern: /^export async function searchByImage(file, { altText = "", useBackendIfAvailable = true } = {}) {$/
